resources.string: Detects when an app you have limited comes to the front and closes it when today\'s time runs out. It only watches the apps you limit and reads no screen content.
Two permissions and you are done. Nothing leaves the phone: this app has no internet access.
Lets the app see which app is in front and close it when its time runs out. It only listens to the apps you limit.
Switch greyed out or a \"restricted setting\" message? Open App info, tap the ⋮ menu, choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
Shows how long you have used each app today. It only reads the history Android already keeps and costs no battery.
Allow notifications to get a warning 5 minutes before an app\'s time runs out.
You have used up today\'s time for %1$s.
